description: Window-level features computed from MediaPipe Face Mesh landmarks over a sliding window. Shared contract between frontend (live inference + data export), backend (/api/predict) and ml/ (training).

features.name: ear_mean
features.description: Mean Eye Aspect Ratio (both eyes) over the window

features.name: ear_std
features.description: Standard deviation of EAR over the window

features.name: perclos
features.description: PERCLOS: fraction of frames with eyes closed (EAR below calibrated threshold)

features.name: blink_rate
features.description: Blinks per minute (closures shorter than the microsleep limit)

features.name: longest_closure
features.description: Longest continuous eye closure in the window (microsleep indicator)

features.name: mar_mean
features.description: Mean Mouth Aspect Ratio over the window

features.name: yawn_rate
features.description: Yawns per minute (MAR above threshold for >= 1 s)

features.name: pitch_mean
features.description: Mean head pitch (positive = head tilted down)

features.name: yaw_std
features.description: Std of head yaw (looking around / distraction)
